title: Morning Brief — Friday, 16 October 2026
description: Regional airline Rex secures its future under new ownership with federal financing support, Queensland crime victim numbers fall nearly 10% over two years, and Gold Coast Airport pushes for new direct international routes after a strong year of growth. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
